description: Localization file for the Select2 plugin, providing Finnish translations for various user interface messages.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns Finnish translation for loading errors.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns Finnish message when input exceeds maximum length.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns Finnish message when input is shorter than minimum requirement.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns Finnish message indicating more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns Finnish message when maximum number of selections is reached.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns Finnish message indicating no search results found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns Finnish message indicating search in progress.
